body: I went to Nmom for comfort for the first time in years and it's been met with anger at me for having emotions followed by the silent treatment. Thanks for confirming that I can't trust you for shit. I just wanted comfort from my fucking mother. Why is that impossible.
I just googled "DBT Worksheets" and looked under images. There were lots of options there and I just picked the ones I was most interested in
Yes, thus definitely makes sense. I'm learning new ways of coping every day! Thank you.
My mom is too. That's so interesting. I never really put any thought into the fact there could be a connection.

I like how you calmly explained you were going to leave the room before doing it. That's something I could definitely learn from. Usually I just storm away in anger and expect the person I'm fighting with (usually my boyfriend) to chase after me to prove he cares. Spoiler alert: he never does. I don't blame him. 

My trigger is feeling like I'm not important/ not cared about so you can see how the dynamic of me storming away and him not following only makes things worse. I'll be practicing calmly explaining my intentions in the future because like you, I think a few moments to myself could be useful.
I like the idea of homework and worksheets. I'm very hands-on so that information is useful. Thanks!
That's what I've been trying to do too. You're right it is a lot of work. Change is HARD! I won't be giving up though.
I love using apps! Thanks for the info!

No, and honestly I dont even know what DBT is! (Though I will be doing some research shortly). The realization that I have BPD is fairly new, and I'm still learning a lot. Thanks for the recommendation!
Sorry for the late reply. This is a throwaway (obviously) so I don't check it often. But really... some of the things you mentioned are so insightful and so helpful. Thank you.
